questions.q: Why does copying Salesforce data into a warehouse increase governance risk?
options: Salesforce profiles, sharing rules, and field-level security don't automatically follow the copy
questions.explain: Controls inside Salesforce protect data there; the copy is governed by whatever the destination platform enforces.

questions.q: What is the safest way to handle a sensitive field that no dashboard needs?
options: Replicate it and hide the column in dashboards
Copy it to several places for safety
Leave it out of the ingestion job entirely
Email it to the data team
questions.explain: Data minimization: data you never copy can't leak from the copy.

questions.q: What does hashing an email column in a staging model let you do?
options: Recover the original address at any time
Count distinct people and join datasets without exposing the address in the clear
questions.explain: Masking preserves analytic utility while reducing exposure, though the method should be approved by security since simple hashes have weaknesses.

questions.q: A customer requests erasure and the record is deleted in Salesforce. What else is required?
options: Propagating the deletion to warehouse tables, models, CRM Analytics datasets, and exports, using a tested path
questions.explain: Every copy must reflect the deletion, and incremental syncs can miss deletes, so the path must be built and tested.

questions.q: What does a data steward provide?
options: A named person who can explain what a data set means, who may use it, and when it changes
questions.explain: Stewards give accountability and context for each major object; legal obligations still come from legal counsel.
